about: The judgments the remediation cannot read from a source, each with the evidence it was made from, for the repository's maintainers to confirm or correct. role is the GOVERNANCE.md 5 use case the uor-repo-tier app maps to a tier. status is STANDARDS.md's Status tag for a live repository; archived repositories take archived from GitHub. domains are the STANDARDS.md Domain tags that apply. owners are the .github/CODEOWNERS entries; until maintainers record themselves, the Organization Owner owns each repository. holder is the copyright holder a drafted LICENSE names, the one the Foundation's own repositories (prism, research, UOR-Framework) already name.
